data.title: 冬马和纱 · 后台的最后一遍
data.description: 候场的小琴房里，她低头轻触琴键，只确认开头几个音的力度。
data.action: sitting at a piano with fingertips on the keys
data.promptProse: Seated before a glossy black concert grand piano in the quiet backstage area backstage, Kazusa rests her pale, slender fingertips lightly on the ivory keys without pressing them down. Dramatic high-contrast theatrical spotlighting spills through the edge of the acoustic baffling, outlining her sharp profile and disheveled black hair in stark chiaroscuro.
data.animaCaption: Soft backstage light illuminates her face and fingers as she plays the piano.
